name: mpdantic
description: Audits and repairs a music library for MPD: output buffer sizing by RAM, .mpdignore management, CUE sheet repair, playlist rebasing, tag validation. Rust core, thin Node shell.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Pedantic about your library, so MPD does not choke on it. Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management pages on the player. Those pages are open to the player's network, as Volumio's own are: anyone who can reach the player can read and write the library from them; every write is undoable. Press Update library when ready — Volumio rebuilds its album list once then, which takes a while on a large library.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.8 Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management pages on the player: sizes MPD's output buffer to the player's memory, manages .mpdignore files, checks and repairs CUE sheets, rebases and imports playlists, renames and organises folders from tags; every write is previewed first and undoable; Update library rebuilds MPD and Volumio's albums once, when you ask.
